# dsh-deep-search

> **Stop letting your DSH agent conclude from a single search.**
> Multi-round iterative deep resear
ch · 14 platform-targeted retrievers · A/B/C/D source grading · cross-validation · misinformation he
latform-targeted retrievers · A/B/C/D source grading · cross-validation · misinformation heuristics.
A one-shot `web_search` answering "has model X shipped?" — with an aggregator's clickbait headline —
is how hallucinated facts get into your context.
**dsh-deep-search** makes the *plan → parallel-retrieve → parse → rewrite → verify* loop the **defau
lt behavior** of a DSH session. The intelligence is your session model; the grunt work (dedup, clust
ering, trust grading, rumor flags) is the plugin. Zero forced payments: no API key needed for the co
re platforms; quota-exhausted engines fall to the back of the chain and self-heal.

## Architecture

des, budgets, and reports honestly. See SKILL.md for the full protocol.

# dsh-deep-search

> **让你的 DSH 不再一次搜索就下结论。**
> 多轮迭代深度检索 · 14 平台定向 · 来源可信度分级 (A/B/C/D) · 交叉验证 · 虚假信息检测
一次 `web_search` 就回答"XX 发布了没有"？模型把聚合站的标题党当成事实、把"没搜到"说成"不存在"？
**dsh-deep-search** 把「查询规划 → 并行检索 → 解析 → 重写 → 验证分级」这套多轮迭代协议变成 DSH 会话的默认行为。智能由你的会话模型驱动，苦力由插件承担——去重、聚类
、可信度分级、虚假信号检测全部自动完成。全程零强制付费依赖：不配任何 API Key 也能跑满核心平台，配额耗尽的引擎自动退避到链尾并自愈。
